Apply one shared Dense token-classifier projection independently to every timestep.

This is a specific bias-enabled Dense sequence head, not a generic wrapper. It reshapes [batch, sequence, features] to token rows, uses the existing trainable LinearModule, and restores the sequence shape.

| | |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Projection | Per-timestep Output Units | `units` | Integer | `128` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Shared Dense output width for every timestep. Required. |
| Projection | Tie to Embedding | `tie_embedding` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Language-model head: reuse the upstream Embedding table as this projection (tied input/output embeddings, GPT-2 and most small LMs), logits = h E^T with no bias. Needs input width = embedding_dim and units = vocabulary size. Saves vocabulary x width parameters (about 1M for an 8,192-token, width-128 model). |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Usage

```text
Input [batch, sequence, features] becomes [batch, sequence, units]. This node is a specific Dense sequence head, not a generic layer wrapper.
```

## Tips

- Use after a sequence-producing recurrent or transformer layer.
- All timesteps share the same weights and bias.
- tie_embedding needs input width = embedding_dim and units = vocabulary size; PyTorch export does not cover this node yet.
